title: Bind Method Flow commands to the current runner interface
failure_signature: The runner rejected inherited append-method and append-witness names before ledger mutation.
trigger_preconditions: A current Method Flow runner is selected
Subcommand names are supplied from recollection rather than current help
Argument parsing occurs before ledger access
candidate_workaround: Read command-specific help and use record --record-file and witness --witness-file against the existing ledger.
recurrence_guard: Copy subcommands and flags from the selected runner help at lifecycle transitions.
rollback: No ledger rollback is needed when parsing stops before access; retain the parser failure and retry with the exact interface.
scope_boundary: This method concerns runner invocation only and cannot validate proposal outcomes or external gates.
